visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: FAQ list under a 'Frequently Asked Questions' H2: question rows separated by thin grey rules, chevron toggle at the right edge, collapsed by default; answers are rich text (paragraphs, lists, links, footnote superscripts).
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expand/collapse FAQ list of questions and rich answers
visualCharacteristics.description: Question rows with grey dividers and right-aligned chevrons; rich answers

contentPattern.summary: Interactive expand/collapse FAQ: one row per question (title cell) and answer (content cell).
contentPattern.structure: one row per question with two cells: cell 1 the question text, cell 2 the answer (paragraphs, lists, links). The FAQ heading stays default content above the block

usage.description: Frequently Asked Questions list on newsroom story pages (5 questions on samsung-holiday).

reuseGuidance: Use for question/answer lists. For small-print text behind a text link use accordion-expand-text.
